business_metrics_definition_confirmation.name: business_metrics_definition_confirmation_is_complete
business_metrics_definition_confirmation.value:
("business_metrics"."definition_confirmed_by_person_id" IS NULL AND "business_metrics"."definition_confirmed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("business_metrics"."definition_confirmed_by_person_id" IS NOT NULL AND "business_metrics"."definition_confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL)

evidence_ai_requires_query.name: evidence_ai_requires_query
evidence_ai_requires_query.value:
"evidence"."ai_sourced" = false
        OR ("evidence"."research_query" IS NOT NULL AND "evidence"."research_tool" IS NOT NULL)

evidence_resolution_requires_human.name: evidence_resolution_requires_human
evidence_resolution_requires_human.value:
"evidence"."citation_resolved" = false
        OR ("evidence"."citation_resolved_by_person_id" IS NOT NULL AND "evidence"."citation_resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

evidence_attestation_is_complete.name: evidence_attestation_is_complete
evidence_attestation_is_complete.value:
("evidence"."attested_by_person_id" IS NULL AND "evidence"."attested_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("evidence"."attested_by_person_id" IS NOT NULL AND "evidence"."attested_at" IS NOT NULL)

persons_scoped_to_exactly_one.name: persons_scoped_to_exactly_one
persons_scoped_to_exactly_one.value: ("persons"."tenant_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("persons"."institution_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1

reflections_human_review_before_ratifica.name: reflections_human_review_before_ratification
reflections_human_review_before_ratifica.value: "reflections"."status" NOT IN ('ratified','active') OR ("reflections"."reviewed_by_person_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reflections"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

stewardship_returns_requires_source.name: stewardship_returns_requires_source
stewardship_returns_requires_source.value: "stewardship_returns"."source_reflection_id" IS NOT NULL OR "stewardship_returns"."source_value_outcome_id" IS NOT NULL

value_outcomes_measured_requires_actual.name: value_outcomes_measured_requires_actual
value_outcomes_measured_requires_actual.value: "value_outcomes"."realization" = 'claimed' OR ("value_outcomes"."actual_value" IS NOT NULL AND "value_outcomes"."actual_measured_at" IS NOT NULL)

value_outcomes_verified_requires_human.name: value_outcomes_verified_requires_human
value_outcomes_verified_requires_human.value: "value_outcomes"."realization" <> 'verified' OR ("value_outcomes"."verified_by_person_id" IS NOT NULL AND "value_outcomes"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "value_outcomes"."source_verified" = true)

value_outcomes_impact_requires_basis.name: value_outcomes_impact_requires_basis
value_outcomes_impact_requires_basis.value:
("value_outcomes"."claimed_currency_impact" IS NULL AND "value_outcomes"."realized_currency_impact" IS NULL)
        OR "value_outcomes"."impact_basis" IS NOT NULL

value_outcomes_commit_is_complete.name: value_outcomes_commit_is_complete
value_outcomes_commit_is_complete.value: "value_outcomes"."committed_at" IS NULL OR ("value_outcomes"."target_value" IS NOT NULL AND "value_outcomes"."committed_by_person_id" IS NOT NULL)

value_runs_lock_is_complete.name: value_runs_lock_is_complete
value_runs_lock_is_complete.value:
"value_runs"."locked_at" IS NULL
        OR ("value_runs"."locked_by_person_id" IS NOT NULL AND "value_runs"."lock_reason" IS NOT NULL)
